answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 236 identities costs 236 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The kernel test is the live device, the jetty test is the locked stake, and the inlet test is the graded history no template can fake.
